result.rationale: The handler creates attendee rows via prisma.booking.update (createMany) before calling eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees, which is not wrapped in a transaction or try/catch. If the calendar update rejects, the DB rows persist, and on retry uniqueGuests filters out any guest already in booking.attendees ('!booking.attendees.some((attendee) => guest === attendee.email)'), yielding empty uniqueGuests and throwing BAD_REQUEST 'emails_must_be_unique_valid' — so the operation cannot be retried and the user gets a confusing error despite guests already being added. This partial-failure/non-atomic
